reuse.why: Uses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but writes its own daily-skip-or-move weekend branch, a decision getUpcomingDates and getNextDate already make separately.

duplication.why: The `skipWeekend` + `frequency === 'daily'` skip-versus-move logic becomes a third copy alongside getUpcomingDates and getNextDate.

placement.why: Handler lives next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered like its siblings; the per-occurrence adjustment would sit better in shared/schedules.ts with the other weekend helpers.

scope.why: Adds only the handler, its type entry and tests.

maintainability.why: Readable and typed (RecurConfig), but weekend rules now have to be kept in sync across three functions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared skip/move helper exists in this tree; the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend is used.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange restates getUpcomingDates' daily-skip / move-to-weekday branch as nested ifs within one occurrence loop instead of extracting it.
